_comment: Cell of Gemini CLI for Abschrift (Abschrift plan v12: E5, A5, A9). Used only by vm/abschrift/start_gemini.sh; never start gemini without it. Gemini CLI writes its clone (except tests/acceptance/, read-only) and ~/.gemini; it sees no other project, no ~/.bashrc and no API key (so it logs in with the AI Pro account, not with GEMINI_API_KEY). Login without a browser: NO_BROWSER=true prints a URL; open it on any device and paste the code back.
